reviews.comment: Class requires everything to be turned in on paper. No late work accepted, period. Unfortunate. Required in SPMT, so oh well.
It's not a bad class but make sure you meet all rubric requirements on your essays or you will get bad grades.
Professor Jones is really nice and her class isn't very hard. Attendance is mandatory because everything you turn in is on paper. A lot of papers but she gives you feedback and they're super short.

reviews.comment: She does not use Canvas, so it is important you pay attention in class and use the handouts she gives because there are weekly quizzes over the material. She grades gracefully and also gives back really good feedback so you know exactly what you did wrong.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is sport finance. Take notes on the slideshows everyday. If you use an tablet and smart pencil you can download the slides and write everything you need on there. Only 2 tests closed note and no formulas. Final project is worth over 50% of grade. Her grading on the project does not make much sense and my grade dropped a lot from it.

This class is the one hour course for Sport Management Majors that prepares you to chose your culminating experience. To apply for the culminating experience, you have to write an essay for each of the 4 options (Internship, Capstone, International, Research). Boring overall but not too hard. I got internship which was my first choice.
